text:
emily: Received enterprise customer report: generate requests return 403 while embeddings work. Customer says key was provisioned via SSO. Repro attached.

emily: REPRO STEPS
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***redacted***"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"Hello"}'
```

emily: RESPONSE
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": {
    "type": "insufficient_scope",
    "message": "API key missing required scope: inference.generate",
    "details": "Key scopes: [embeddings.read]"
  }
}
```

rahul: Can you DM me the key id and org id? I'll check the provisioning logs.

emily: Key id: key_01G3XYZ... Org: org-88ac

infra-bot: [provisioner] 2026-07-13T14:22:10Z created_key id=key_01G3XYZ template=embeddings_only actor=ssoprovisioner user=svc-okta

rahul: Confirmed - provisioner used 'embeddings_only' template. That template intentionally omits inference/rerank scopes.

emily: Customer expected a general-purpose key for dev work. They used the 'SSO -> API keys' flow; mapping probably misconfigured in Okta.

oncall-mike: Short-term fix: advise customer to create a new key via Console with 'inference' + 'embeddings' scopes, or we can issue a replacement key. I'll also add a guard in the provisioning flow to warn when a service requests generate endpoints with insufficient scopes.

product-ana: Can we update SSO app mapping for the 'developer' role to include inference.generate and embeddings.read by default? Also add UI copy to warn about "embeddings-only" template.

rahul: I'll push a quick patch to the provisioner: if template==embeddings_only and client_app_id in [console, sdk, generate] then auto-add inference scope. Deploying to staging now.

infra-bot: Deploy started: provisioner v2.14.1 -> staging
infra-bot: Deploy succeeded: provisioner v2.14.1 -> staging

rahul: Patch rolled to prod. Provisioner now attaches inference.generate when SSO app signals interactive developer intent. Also added audit log entry for template mismatch.

emily: Can you share suggested support reply? I'll send to customer.

oncall-mike: Suggested reply:
"Thanks — we found the issue: your SSO provisioning flow issued an embeddings-only key. Generate endpoints require the 'inference' scope. You can: 1) Create a new key in Console and select both 'Generate/Chat' and 'Embeddings'; or 2) Ask us to rotate a key for you (we can preserve labels). We've updated our SSO provisioning to add the inference scope for developer mappings to prevent future cases."

emily: Sent to customer. They confirmed rotating key fixed the generate calls. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
